title: Ton enfant parle tard. Et alors ?
style_dna: Authentic documentary family photography. Cinematic warm natural light, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, natural skin texture, European home interiors. Emotional, intimate, never stocky. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no watermark, no logo in image.

composition_rules.caption_safe_zone: Captions render between y=62% and y=78% of frame height. Keep faces and key subjects in the upper 55% of the frame; keep the lower third visually calm (floor, bokeh, fabric, shadow).
composition_rules.tiktok_ui_safe_zone: Avoid critical detail in the right 12% (like/share rail) and bottom 20% (description bar).
composition_rules.vertical_negative_space: Generous headroom or footroom so the 1.08-1.16x Ken Burns zoom never crops the subject's face.

scenes.vo: Ton enfant parle tard. Et alors ? Pendant qu'il se tait, son cerveau construit autre chose. Quelque chose de précieux.
